description.narrative: The PDO is to strengthen key institutional and regulatory functions of the Ministry of Environment (MOEn). These key functions will enable MOEn to undertake environmental policy analysis and coordination, formulate laws and regulations, monitor environmental quality, promote environmental awareness and conduct technical studies.

title.narrative: MOEn undertake policy analysis, revise its environmental law and regulations, acquire capacity to monitor air quality in 3 cities, and successfully launches awareness campaigns in selected schools

baseline.value: MOEn has very limited capacity in environmental management

target.value: Environmental Action Plan prepared. EIA decree and other regulations revised. Air quality portable equipment installed andcredibledata generated. Awareness tools and campaigns distributed to schools

actual.value: The final REAP was approved by the Minister on May 26, 2012. Cost of Environmental Degradation (COED) study was finalized andshared with line Ministries, EIA guidelines were developed. Air quality monitoring stations operational and data being generatedwith some constraints. Awareness activity coducted.

title.narrative: MOEn undertake policy analysis, revise its environmental law and regulations, acquire capacity to monitor air quality in 3 cities, and successfully launches awareness campaigns in selected schools

baseline.value: MOEn has very limited capacity in environmental management

target.value: Environmental Action Plan prepared. EIA decree and other regulations revised. Air quality portable equipment installed andcredibledata generated. Awareness tools and campaigns distributed to schools

actual.value: The final reports of reviewing the environmental law, air pollution regulation, water resources regulations and environmentalassessment regulation were submitted to the Legal Directorate and the Technical directorate to take the recommendations into theirconsideration for updating of the existing regulations. All the equipments of the 10 air quality monitoring stations were installedand some of them were calibrated. Awareness campaigns have been completed.

title.narrative: Outcome Indicator 5: MOEn staff with adequate technical capacity to manage municipal and health care waste

baseline.value: The capacity of MOEn staff to manage municipal and healthcare waste is weak

target.value: MOEn staff with adequate technical capacity to manage municipal and health care waste

actual.value: The final Action Plan report for the Health Care Waste Management has been completed and shared with H.E. Minister ofEnvironment,Technical Deputy Minister, Minister Advisor, General Inspector, and all members of the Council for EnvironmentProtection and Improvement. Ministry of Health was also provided with a copy of the report for their investments. The final MasterPlan report for the Municipal Waste Management has been completed and shared with the same stakeholders. Mayoralty of Baghdad wasalso provided with a copy of the report for their investments. Baghdad Provincial Council even requested a copy.
